cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Research Specialist to join our team.
The animal program involves all aspects of animal use for research, teaching, and outreach. [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Program Coordinator to join their Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services team. The Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services Core provides research support across all animal programs on campus. The Breeding Core breeds over 500 strains of mice and rats. Staff commonly breed mice for specific projects, perform studies inside the core facility, and deliver end point tissues or transfer live mice to laboratories after techniques are performed. Support ranges from a small portion of study to a complete study with final results.
This position will report to the Director of Research Services. The overall responsibility of this position will be planning and coordinating the administrative, operational, outreach and promotional activities related to research studies that may be collaborative and independent and serves as a subject matter expert. This position will develop charge backs, provide quotes and work with [Company name masked] and industry contracts. They will also manage Standard Operating procedures, training documents and keep research records. They will coordinate project needs with researchers and work closely with the Director of Research Services, Animal Care Manager and Client Based Researchers to ensure compliance, order research supplies and secure resources to start projects. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both collaboratively and independently are essential. Organization, time management and attention to detail are imperative for success in this position.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develops, designs, and conducts one or more research projects and organizes daily operation of projects and specialized research areas to ensure work meets established objectives under moderate supervision.
50% Conducts research experiments according to established research protocols with moderate impact to the project(s). Collects data and monitors test results
10% Operates, cleans, and maintains organization of research equipment and research area. Tracks inventory levels and places replenishment orders
5% Reviews, analyzes, and interprets data and/or documents results for presentations and/or reporting to internal and external audiences
5% Participates in the development, interpretation, and implementation of research methodology and materials
5% Provides operational guidance on day-to-day activities of unit or program staff and/or student workers
5% Performs literature reviews and writes reports
20% Colony management of rodents
cond_0001.requirements:
Education:
Bachelor's Degree
Minimum Requirements
At least 1 year of experience in a biomedical research setting
Minimum of 2 years' experience working in an animal research setting
Knowledge of rodent breeding strategies and animal models
Demonstrated experience with accurate record keeping and compliance
Ability to multitask, stay organized and pay attention to detail
Preferred Requirements
Focus in a biomedical or animal related field
Experience in professional correspondence with faculty, researchers and their staff
Proficient computer skills, including knowledge of working with Excel and databases
Ability to use effective team building skills to create and maintain efficient operation of the work unit
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

The animal program involves all aspects of animal use for research, teaching, and outreach. [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Specialist to join their Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services team. The Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services Core provides research support across all animal programs on campus. The Breeding Core breeds over 500 strains of mice and rats. Staff commonly breed mice for specific projects, perform studies inside the core facility, and deliver end point tissues or transfer live mice to laboratories after techniques are performed. Support ranges from a small portion of study to a complete study with final results.
This position will report to the Director of Research Services. The overall responsibility of this position will be planning and coordinating the administrative, operational, outreach and promotional activities related to research studies that may be collaborative and independent and serves as a subject matter expert. This position will develop charge backs, provide quotes and work with [Company name masked] and industry contracts. They will also manage Standard Operating procedures, training documents and keep research records. They will coordinate project needs with researchers and work closely with the Director of Research Services, Animal Care Manager and Client Based Researchers to ensure compliance, order research supplies and secure resources to start projects. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both collaboratively and independently are essential. Organization, time management and attention to detail are imperative for success in this position.
cond_0056.responsibilities:
Develops, designs, and conducts one or more research projects and organizes daily operation of projects and specialized research areas to ensure work meets established objectives under moderate supervision.
50% Conducts research experiments according to established research protocols with moderate impact to the project(s). Collects data and monitors test results
10% Operates, cleans, and maintains organization of research equipment and research area. Tracks inventory levels and places replenishment orders
5% Reviews, analyzes, and interprets data and/or documents results for presentations and/or reporting to internal and external audiences
5% Participates in the development, interpretation, and implementation of research methodology and materials
5% Provides operational guidance on day-to-day activities of unit or program staff and/or student workers
5% Performs literature reviews and writes reports
20% Colony management of rodents
cond_0056.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a biomedical or animal-related field required.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise working in an animal research setting.
At least 1 year of proven experience in a biomedical research setting.
Deep knowledge of rodent breeding strategies and animal models.
Demonstrated track record of accurate record keeping and compliance.
Preferred Requirements
Strong command of professional correspondence with faculty, researchers, and their staff.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and database systems.
Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain close attention to detail.
Strong ability to apply effective team-building skills to create and maintain efficient operation of the work unit.

[Company name masked] is looking for a motivated team-player to coordinate research efforts in their Research Services and Breeding Core.
The [Company name masked] animal program involves all aspects of animal use for research, teaching, and outreach. [Company name masked], the School of Medicine and Public Health's animal care department, is seeking a Research Program Coordinator to join their Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services team. Support ranges from a small portion of study to a complete study with final results.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both collaboratively and independently are essential. cond_0164.intro:
We are looking for a Research Specialist to join our team.
The animal program involves all aspects of animal use for research, teaching, and outreach. [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Specialist to join their Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services team. The Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services Core provides research support across all animal programs on campus. The Breeding Core breeds over 500 strains of mice and rats. Staff commonly breed mice for specific projects, perform studies inside the core facility, and deliver end point tissues or transfer live mice to laboratories after techniques are performed. Support ranges from a small portion of study to a complete study with final results.
This position will report to the Director of Research Services. The overall responsibility of this position will be planning and coordinating the administrative, operational, outreach and promotional activities related to research studies that may be collaborative and independent and serves as a subject matter expert. This position will develop charge backs, provide quotes and work with [Company name masked] and industry contracts. They will also manage Standard Operating procedures, training documents and keep research records. They will coordinate project needs with researchers and work closely with the Director of Research Services, Animal Care Manager and Client Based Researchers to ensure compliance, order research supplies and secure resources to start projects. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both collaboratively and independently are essential. Organization, time management and attention to detail are imperative for success in this position.

The animal program involves all aspects of animal use for research, teaching, and outreach. [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Program Coordinator to join their Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services team. The Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services Core provides research support across all animal programs on campus. The Breeding Core breeds over 500 strains of mice and rats. Staff commonly breed mice for specific projects, perform studies inside the core facility, and deliver end point tissues or transfer live mice to laboratories after techniques are performed. Support ranges from a small portion of study to a complete study with final results.
This position will report to the Director of Research Services. The overall responsibility of this position will be planning and coordinating the administrative, operational, outreach and promotional activities related to research studies that may be collaborative and independent and serves as a subject matter expert. This position will develop charge backs, provide quotes and work with [Company name masked] and industry contracts. They will also manage Standard Operating procedures, training documents and keep research records. They will coordinate project needs with researchers and work closely with the Director of Research Services, Animal Care Manager and Client Based Researchers to ensure compliance, order research supplies and secure resources to start projects. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both collaboratively and independently are essential. Organization, time management and attention to detail are imperative for success in this position.
cond_0226.responsibilities:
Develops, designs, and conducts one or more research projects and organizes daily operation of projects and specialized research areas to ensure work meets established objectives under moderate supervision.
50% Conducts research experiments according to established research protocols with moderate impact to the project(s). Collects data and monitors test results
10% Operates, cleans, and maintains organization of research equipment and research area. Tracks inventory levels and places replenishment orders
5% Reviews, analyzes, and interprets data and/or documents results for presentations and/or reporting to internal and external audiences
5% Participates in the development, interpretation, and implementation of research methodology and materials
5% Provides operational guidance on day-to-day activities of unit or program staff and/or student workers
5% Performs literature reviews and writes reports
20% Colony management of rodents
cond_0226.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree
Focus in a biomedical or animal related field preferred
At least 1 year of experience in Biomedical research setting.
Experience in professional correspondence with faculty, researchers and their staff.
Proficient computer skills, including knowledge of working with Excel and databases.
Ability to multitask, stay organized and pay attention to detail.
Minimum of 2 years' experience working in an animal research setting.

cond_0254.intro:
We are looking for a Research Specialist to join our team.
The animal program involves all aspects of animal use for research, teaching, and outreach. [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Specialist to join their Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services team. The Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services Core provides research support across all animal programs on campus. The Breeding Core breeds over 500 strains of mice and rats. Staff commonly breed mice for specific projects, perform studies inside the core facility, and deliver end point tissues or transfer live mice to laboratories after techniques are performed. Support ranges from a small portion of study to a complete study with final results.
This position will report to the Director of Research Services. The overall responsibility of this position will be planning and coordinating the administrative, operational, outreach and promotional activities related to research studies that may be collaborative and independent and serves as a subject matter expert. This position will develop charge backs, provide quotes and work with [Company name masked] and industry contracts. They will also manage Standard Operating procedures, training documents and keep research records. They will coordinate project needs with researchers and work closely with the Director of Research Services, Animal Care Manager and Client Based Researchers to ensure compliance, order research supplies and secure resources to start projects. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both collaboratively and independently are essential. Organization, time management and attention to detail are imperative for success in this position.
cond_0254.responsibilities:
Develops, designs, and conducts one or more research projects and organizes daily operation of projects and specialized research areas to ensure work meets established objectives under moderate supervision.
50% Conducts research experiments according to established research protocols with moderate impact to the project(s). Collects data and monitors test results
10% Operates, cleans, and maintains organization of research equipment and research area. Tracks inventory levels and places replenishment orders
5% Reviews, analyzes, and interprets data and/or documents results for presentations and/or reporting to internal and external audiences
5% Participates in the development, interpretation, and implementation of research methodology and materials
5% Provides operational guidance on day-to-day activities of unit or program staff and/or student workers
5% Performs literature reviews and writes reports
20% Colony management of rodents

Bachelor's degree in a biomedical or animal-related field required.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise working in an animal research setting.
At least 1 year of proven experience in a biomedical research setting.
Deep knowledge of rodent breeding strategies and animal models.
Demonstrated track record of accurate record keeping and compliance.
Preferred Requirements
Strong command of professional correspondence with faculty, researchers, and their staff.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and database systems.
Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain close attention to detail.
Strong ability to apply effective team-building skills to create and maintain efficient operation of the work unit.

cond_0263.intro:

The animal program involves all aspects of animal use for research, teaching, and outreach. [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Program Coordinator to join their Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services team. The Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services Core provides research support across all animal programs on campus. The Breeding Core breeds over 500 strains of mice and rats. Support ranges from a small portion of study to a complete study with final results.
This position will report to the Director of Research Services. The overall responsibility of this position will be planning and coordinating the administrative, operational, outreach and promotional activities related to research studies that may be collaborative and independent and serves as a subject matter expert. The animal program involves all aspects of animal use for research, teaching, and outreach. [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Specialist to join the Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services team. The Rodent Breeding Core and Research Services Core provides research support across all animal programs on campus. The Breeding Core breeds over 500 strains of mice and rats. Staff regularly breed mice for specific projects, perform studies inside the core facility, and deliver end point tissues or transfer live mice to laboratories after techniques are performed. Support ranges from a small portion of study to a complete study with final results.
This position reports to the Director of Research Services. The overall responsibility of this position is planning and coordinating the administrative, operational, outreach, and promotional activities related to research studies that may be collaborative and independent, and serves as a subject matter expert. This position will develop charge backs, provide quotes, and work with contracts. They will also manage Standard Operating Procedures, training documents, and research records. They will regularly coordinate project needs with researchers and stay in close contact with the Director of Research Services, Animal Care Manager, and Client Based Researchers to ensure compliance, order research supplies, and secure resources to start projects. Strong communication skills and the ability to work both collaboratively and independently are essential. Organization, time management, and attention to detail are imperative for this position.
cond_0411.responsibilities:
Develops, designs, and conducts one or more research projects and organizes daily operation of projects and specialized research areas to ensure work meets established objectives under moderate supervision.
50% Conducts research experiments according to established research protocols with moderate impact to the project(s). Regularly collects data and monitors test results, staying in contact with the team throughout.
10% Operates, cleans, and maintains organization of research equipment and research area. Tracks inventory levels and places replenishment orders.
5% Reviews, analyzes, and interprets data and/or documents results for presentations and/or reporting to internal and external audiences.
5% Actively participates in the development, interpretation, and implementation of research methodology and materials, contributing input and raising questions as needed.
5% Provides operational guidance on day-to-day activities of unit or program staff and/or student workers.
5% Performs literature reviews and writes reports.
20% Colony management of rodents.
cond_0411.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree. Focus in a biomedical or animal related field preferred.
At least 1 year of experience in a biomedical research setting.
Experience in professional correspondence with faculty, researchers, and their staff.
Proficient computer skills, including knowledge of working with Excel and databases.
Ability to multitask, stay organized, and pay attention to detail.
Minimum of 2 years' experience working in an animal research setting.
Knowledge of rodent breeding strategies and animal models.
Demonstrated experience with accurate record keeping and compliance.
Ability to use effective team building skills to create and maintain efficient operation of the work unit.
cond_0411.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0411.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.
